Unclusteryour nextproject.

Uncluster is a blazing-fast, lightweight web/CLI tool built entirely in Go. It turns HTML into React or EJS projects with predictable output. No prompt engineering. No minor in Webflow.

Try Uncluster GitHub repo

How it works.

A brief methodology.
No literature review required.

  1. 01

    Bring a specimen.

    Start with HTML, a public URL, or a saved site ZIP. The specimen need not be elegant.

  2. 02

    Pick an output.

    Split a page into HTML, CSS and JavaScript, or turn HTML into a React or EJS project. Rules handle the conversion. No negotiations with a model.

  3. 03

    Resume your work.

    Download the files and open them in your editor. Edit, run, and build from there. Further experiments are encouraged.
